value: Two-step verification is a requirement for all Shine Online Banking accounts; cannot be removed
quote: Two-step verification is a requirement for all Shine Online Banking accounts. We're unable to remove this security feature from your account as well as the alerts that follow.

value: Add a mobile number to receive two-step codes via text instead of email, via Shine Mobile or Shine Online
quote: If you don't want to receive your two-step codes via email, add your mobile number to receive codes via text instead.

value: Profile > Two Step Notification > Add contact, enter number, follow prompts
quote: Once you're logged in, you can add your number via the "Two Step Notification" option of your Profile. Select "Add contact", enter your number, and follow the prompts.

value: Mouse over Profile, select Edit Profile, then Actions menu > edit two-step and follow prompts
quote: mouse over "Profile", select on "Edit Profile". Under the "Actions" menu on the right hand side, select "edit two-step" and follow the prompts on screen.

value: Enable face or fingerprint recognition or PIN Login via Device Security section of Profile
quote: Enable face or fingerprint recognition or setup PIN Login. Once you're logged in, you can configure either option from the Device Security section of your Profile.

value: Choose 'Trust this device' on login screen; not recommended for devices you don't own
quote: Choose "Trust" this device" (on your login screen). Doing so secures your account with the most recent login code entered.

attribute: manage transaction, balance or statement alerts
value: Log in to Shine Online Banking and go to the eNotifiers section
quote: login to Shine Online Banking and navigate to the eNotifiers section where you can configure which alerts you would like to receive.

attribute: member services phone for mistaken alerts
quote: please give us a call at 800-373-7600, ext. 0 or contact us at service@dupaco.com.
qualifiers: Mistaken verification codes or alerts not belonging to member
Mistaken verification codes or alerts not belonging to member

value: Dupaco will remove the member's number or email from the associated account upon request
quote: we will remove your number or email from the associated account.
qualifiers: Transaction or account alert that isn't yours
